ackTimeoutHelp: How long an emit that asked for an answer waits before it is reported as unanswered.
appliesOnNextConnect: Changes apply when the connection reconnects.
defaultsHelp: What every connection dials with while its own settings say nothing else. A connection that changes one keeps that one, and only that one.
deleteBody: “{{name}}” is removed from the workspace. This cannot be undone.
enginePathHelp: Where the server mounts Engine.IO. Not the namespace: change it only if the server did.
engineTransportHelp: How the connection is carried. Polling only helps when something between here and the server refuses the WebSocket upgrade.
frameTemplateHelp: JSON the outgoing message is wrapped in. The holes it takes are the event name and the message itself, {{event}} and {{payload}}, and variables of the environment resolve too. Empty sends the message as it is.
heading: Connections
initialWaitHelp: Doubles on every attempt until it reaches the maximum wait.
keepaliveHelp: If the pong does not arrive within the timeout, the connection is taken as dropped.
maximumMessageSizeHelp: A larger frame closes the connection instead of reserving memory for it.
namespaceHelp: Which namespace to join. «/» is the default one every server exposes.
noConnectionOpenBody: Every open connection takes a tab of this group.
noEventOpen: Select an event from the collections
noEventOpenBody: The event you open is composed here and sent through this connection.
payloadTooBig: Too large to lay out: shown as it came.
retryHelp: Does not affect a failed first attempt or a manual disconnection.
retrySetting: Reconnect when the server hangs up
effectiveUrlHelp: The url the connection dials: params appended, variables resolved.
spreadHelp: Randomizes each wait by this percentage, so connections that drop together do not retry at once.
subprotocolsHelp: Comma separated, in order of preference.
transportHelp: Which protocol this connection speaks. Changing it starts from that transport's defaults, URL included.
transportPendingDetail: This transport is saved with the connection. Dialing for it is on its way.
handshakeTimeoutHelp: How long the connection waits for the server to answer the opening handshake before it gives up.
socketioVersionHelp: The Socket.IO version the server speaks. v4 also reaches v3 servers; v2 servers only understand v2.
scriptDroppedDetail_one: Dropped: {{count}}. A message no script ran on, or a socket.send that did not leave.
scriptDroppedDetail_other: Dropped: {{count}}. Messages no script ran on, and socket.send calls that did not leave.
scriptsHelp: Scripts do not write the auth or the subprotocols of the connection.
scriptSecretsOffDestination: A script changed the destination: it opened without secrets
scriptSecretsOffDestinationHint: Put the host in the environment and the secrets go along.
scriptSecretsOffPolling: Opened without secrets: polling follows redirects. “WebSocket only” avoids it
scriptSwitchedOff_one: Scripts are off: {{count}} did not run
scriptSwitchedOff_other: Scripts are off: {{count}} did not run
